name: globe
title: Globe
description: An autorotating, interactive and highly performant globe made using WebGL.

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the wrapper. It is absolutely positioned and square, so place it in a relative container and offset it (e.g. top-28).

props.name: config
props.default: Magic UI's white globe with 10 markers
props.description: cobe options (colours, markers, arcs, theta, dark, …) merged over the defaults. width, height and phi are managed by the component. See cobe.vercel.app.
